Planner: Hardworking run on quiet areas just now. Keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk moving. The welfare coordinator needs calm handoffs and clear notes.
Coordinator: <<FACT F085>> I need pet comfort checks pushed ahead.
Planner: Understood. No delays on carrier review or cabin fit. Aurelia Skyways expects steady follow-through for every animal.
Dispatcher: I will alert the handler team and keep the desk light. Toby can stay settled if the documents are clean.
Coordinator: Good, and keep the travelers briefed in plain language. We need patient attention from trained staff all the way.
Planner: Copy that. The transfer path is open, the prep is clean, and the team is ready.
